entry.question:
## Physical scenario

An object is at \( x = 0 \) at \( t = 0 \) and moves along the \( x \) axis according to the velocity--time graph in figure.

## Question

Through what total distance has the object moved between \( t = 0 \) and \( t = 18.0 \text{ s} \)?

## Answer choices

- A: A: 272m

- B: B: 136m

- C: C: 204m

- D: D: 182m

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image is a velocity-time graph showing the velocity \( v_x \) (in meters per second) on the y-axis and time \( t \) (in seconds) on the x-axis. The graph consists of a series of linear segments:

1. From \( t = 0 \) to \( t = 5 \) seconds, the velocity increases linearly from -10 m/s to 20 m/s.
2. From \( t = 5 \) to \( t = 10 \) seconds, the velocity remains constant at 20 m/s.
3. From \( t = 10 \) to \( t = 15 \) seconds, the velocity decreases linearly back to -10 m/s.

The grid is labeled at intervals of 5 for time and 10 for velocity. The path of the graph is highlighted by a thick brown line.

## Dataset metadata

Kinematics; Spatial Relation Reasoning, Multi-Formula Reasoning
